title: Tilted Conveyor
body:
"WEEE!"


The Tilted Conveyor is a structure that can be bought from The Oak Depot. It is a sloping straight section of conveyor belt.

Appearance

The Tilted Conveyor is identical in functionality to the Straight Conveyor. However, the Tilted Conveyor operates at an angle, allowing it to move objects vertically. This can be used to create conveyor systems that go under/over each other, or to lift objects high enough to be dumped into a truck.

The Tilted Conveyor, when unboxed, is a 6×4×6 object, and feeds resources upwards. Like the Straight Conveyor, it can be resized to be as short as 3 studs in length, or as long as 24 studs in length. The Tilted Conveyor has a minimum height of 3 studs and a maximum height of 6 studs.
